dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: Nothing good, that's for sure. The biggest problem is the drop in temperature. Not only does the ice-mining equipment start breaking down, but the workers can't take it either.

dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: And if heavy snow blocks the roads, the trains will have to stop running. At that point, never mind delivering our cargo on time. We may not even be able to get the supplies and parts the town urgently needs.

dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: Still, we’ve already made every preparation we can in advance. All that's left to do now... is pray, I suppose.
